none: PAS GLO-AC64F6: nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: South Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Date 330-340 A.D. Diameter 18mm, weight 2.4g. Obverse: Helmeted, laureate and mantled bust left holding sceptre across shoulder. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINOPOLIS. Reverse Victory standing left, right foot on prow, sceptre in right, resting left on grounded shield. Reverse inscription: none
